title: Ecommerce Executive
description:
Are you commercially minded, analytical and passionate about ecommerce?

We're looking for an Ecommerce Executive to join our Commercial team at H2e Commerce and take ownership of the development, management and presentation of our Office Supplies category across our ecommerce websites. Internally your job title will be "Office Supplies Category Manager".

This is an exciting opportunity for someone with experience in category management, buying, merchandising, ecommerce or a similar commercial role who enjoys working with data, identifying opportunities and turning insight into action.

You'll play a key role in shaping our product range, improving the online customer experience and supporting the continued growth of both branded and own-brand products.

This role is based on site in Winsford with one day working at home after full training. Working hours 8:00am to 4:30pm.

About the Role

You'll work collaboratively with Purchasing, Marketing, Development, Ecommerce Content and the wider Commercial team, giving you the opportunity to make a genuine impact across the business.
- Manage and develop the Office Supplies product range, identifying opportunities for growth and improvement.
- Assess new supplier and OEM product opportunities and support new product introductions.
- Identify range gaps, duplication and opportunities to rationalise or expand the product range.
- Support the development and growth of own-brand products.
- Monitor competitor activity, pricing, market trends and customer demand to identify commercial opportunities and improve our pricing position.
- Analyse sales, margins, pricing and product performance data to inform decisions and recommendations.
- Support promotional campaigns, seasonal activity and marketing initiatives.
- Work with Ecommerce Content teams to ensure products and categories are accurately structured, categorised and presented.
- Identify opportunities to improve product discoverability, on-site search, navigation and the overall customer experience.
- Review and improve category structures and online merchandising.
- Work with Development teams on website and category improvement projects.
- Support merchandising and cross-selling opportunities.
- Provide commercial insight and recommendations to support wider business decisions.

Benefits
- Competitive salary with annual salary reviews
- 30 days annual leave with an additional day of leave for each full year spent with the company, up to 35 days per year
- One day birthday leave each year
- Death in service insurance at 3 x annual salary
- Pension
- Simply Health Plan
- Generous long service cash rewards from 5 years of service
- Cycle to work scheme
- Discounted Gym Memberships
- Staff discount on products
- Staff referral scheme with cash rewards
- GP access and mental health counselling support
- Yearly flu vaccinations
- Specsavers vision/ eye care
- Free parking with easy access to rail and bus routes
- Fun and exciting social and team building events
- Casual dress

Requirements
- Experience in category management, buying, merchandising, ecommerce or a similar commercial role. Preferably within stationery, business supplies or similar.
- Experience managing, developing or optimising product ranges.
- A relevant qualification in Business, Commercial, Marketing, Ecommerce or a similar subject would be beneficial.
- Strong commercial awareness and a data-driven approach to decision making.
- Advanced Excel skills and confidence working with large datasets.
- The ability to analyse sales, margin, pricing and competitor data and turn insight into practical recommendations.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
- A proactive approach, with the confidence to identify opportunities and improvements independently.

title: Marketing Assistant/Analyst I
description:
- Marketing Assistant/Analyst I (UK) (Internal role specification: Marketing Operations Associate)
- Location: Northwich, United Kingdom
- Duration: 1 year contract with potential for extension
- Pay Rate: £16.00 / hour (GBP)

Core Responsibilities
- EPIC / EBS Process Ownership: Drive and manage end-to-end system operations for creating, adjusting, and maintaining part numbers and records in internal systems (EPIC and EBS). Ensure data accuracy, complete information submissions, track approvals, and resolve system workflow bottlenecks.
- Product Management Support: Provide operational support to the Product Management team by tracking agreed actions, following up on cross-functional deliverables, maintaining documentation, and ensuring project timelines are met.

Key Qualifications & Requirements
- System & Process Proficiency: Hands-on experience navigating business systems and structured approval processes (e.g., ERP platforms like SAP).
- Workflow Coordination: Proven ability to manage multi-step, detailed processes across different systems and cross-functional teams with high accuracy and follow-through.
- Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication skills to track down inputs, chase actions diplomatically, and maintain status updates across teams.
- Detail-Oriented & Dependable: High attention to detail regarding data entries/part numbers with a proactive approach to routine, business-critical change control tasks.
- Preferred Experience: Prior background in supply chain, operations, change control, or product management workflows (especially part setup and system maintenance) is highly advantageous.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
MARKETING EXECUTIVE

Marketing, Content & Digital - Growing Financial Services Business
- Based in Chester
- Hands on role spanning content, social media, digital marketing and partner campaigns
- Opportunity to experiment with AI-assisted marketing and content workflows
- Work across multiple channels including social, email, web, video, podcasts and SEO
- Ideal next move for a marketer with 12+ months experience who wants more ownership and exposure

ABOUT THE CLIENT

We're working with an established and growing financial services business that supports organisations across the UK.

They're looking for a Marketing Executive to join their Chester-based marketing team - someone creative, commercially minded and ready to take genuine ownership of their work.

This isn't a role where you'll spend your time doing one small part of marketing. You'll get exposure across campaigns, content, social, brand, partner marketing, customer communications and AI, giving you the opportunity to build a really well-rounded marketing skillset.

THE BENEFITS
- Broad exposure across the full marketing mix
- Opportunity to work on both brand and partner campaigns
- Hands on content creation across written, visual, video and podcast formats
- Exposure to generative AI, prompt engineering and AI-assisted content production
- Opportunity to influence brand voice and messaging
- Work closely with teams across Sales, Operations, Data and wider business functions
- A role where you can take greater ownership and make a visible contribution

THE MARKETING EXECUTIVE ROLE

You'll help bring campaigns and ideas to life across multiple channels, creating marketing that is engaging, consistent and commercially focused.

You'll create content for websites, case studies, social media, email campaigns, blogs, video and podcasts, as well as scheduling and publishing social content.

A big part of the role will also involve partner marketing. You'll help develop tailored campaigns and collateral around different audiences, products and commercial objectives.

There's a particularly interesting AI element too. You'll use approved generative AI tools to improve marketing efficiency, help develop prompt libraries and build repeatable content workflows, while ensuring everything remains accurate, on brand and compliant.

You'll also support competitor research, customer insight, marketing calendars, budget administration and the ongoing development of the organisation's brand voice.

MARKETING EXECUTIVE ESSENTIAL SKILLS
- 12+ months experience within a marketing or campaign focused role
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Good knowledge of digital marketing and social media
- Confident creating engaging content for different channels and audiences
- Excellent attention to detail and proofreading ability
- Ability to juggle multiple campaigns and deadlines
- Commercial mindset with an understanding of how marketing supports wider business objectives
- Degree qualified or equivalent

Experience with generative AI and prompt engineering, Canva or Adobe, Google Analytics, SEO/GEO, partner marketing or stakeholder management would be a real advantage, but isn't essential.

This could be a great next step if you've completed your first marketing role and now want somewhere you can broaden your experience, take ownership and genuinely make an impact.

TO BE CONSIDERED:

Please either apply through this advert or email me directly via

title: Senior Digital Marketing Executive
description:
If you love generating leads and thrive on seeing your marketing directly contribute to sales growth - This is your chance to take the lead.

We're looking for a Senior Digital Marketing Executive to own the marketing function within a growing family business that is a leading supplier of technical chemical solutions. It is a varied role spanning strategy, content, digital marketing, events, and automation

Reporting directly to the CEO, you'll be given the autonomy to shape marketing strategy, build powerful lead generation campaigns, and position the business as the go-to expert within its markets.

From LinkedIn campaigns and technical content to video production, CRM automation, SEO, events, and website optimisation, you'll combine strategic thinking with hands-on delivery to create marketing that drives real commercial results.

With ambitious growth plans across the UK and Europe, we're looking for someone who can consistently attract qualified prospects, convert interest into opportunities, and help fuel the next stage of the company's success.

If you're commercially minded, creative, and passionate about generating leads that convert into customers, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
- Develop and deliver the annual digital marketing strategy.
- Drive qualified lead generation through multiple digital channels.
- Create engaging content including blogs, whitepapers, videos, case studies, and technical resources.
- Manage and grow the company's LinkedIn presence through thought leadership campaigns.
- Plan and execute email marketing campaigns and lead nurturing activities.
- Oversee website performance, SEO optimisation, and content updates.
- Support European market expansion through targeted digital campaigns.

Requirements
- Proven Experience in Digital Marketing
- Proven track record of generating qualified leads through digital channels.
- Experience creating and executing email marketing campaigns.
- Strong website management experience, ideally including Shopify.
- Experience using CRM and marketing automation platforms
- Strong content creation skills, including technical writing.
- Videography, photography, and video editing experience.

Highly Desirable:
- Marketing, Chemistry, or Science-related degree.
- Experience creating technical content or working within technical, manufacturing, engineering, chemical, or industrial sectors.
- Strong Understanding of AI and Marketing automation tools

Benefits
- Starting salary £35,000 - £40,000
- Huge opportunity to own, develop and grow the marketing function.
- High level of autonomy and responsibility.

Please note this is role is 100% office based and it is 40 hour working week but there is flexibility on start and finish times

Hybrid working may be an option further down the line but it is not envisaged will be practical initially.
